description:
This cinematic drone film was made during our Summer 2024 visit to Canmore, Alberta and the Canadian Rockies and is filmed with a DJI Mini 3 Pro. We spend one week at a lovely condo near the center of Canmore with our kids, and some extended family (https://www.vrbo.com/381129). We were honestly blown away each day by the sheer beauty of the nature surrounding us. From Cascade Mountain, Mount Rundle, Ha Ling Peak, Mount Lawrence Grassi, and the Three Sisters dominating the views to the West and South to Grotto Mountain, Mount Lady Macdonald, and Mount Charles Stewart on the East and North, we felt like we were in the middle of a mountain valley paradise. Add to that the stunning Bow River with its milky turquoise water running through the middle of the town and there was no shortage of stunning sights to see. We especially enjoyed the sunrise views of the mountains being slowly illuminated by sunlight. It was cool to see the iconic Canmore Engine Bridge which was featured in HBO's popular show The Last of Us. Canmore was a perfect home base for our hiking and sightseeing adventures as it is located about 10 minutes from Banff National Park and within 60 minutes from nearly all the activities we did during our stay. We will be posting several other videos from the various hikes and activities that we did during our visit to Canada but this film is focused on the sights and beauty of the Canmore area. Special note - flying drones recreationally is prohibited in both the National Parks and Provincial Parks of Canada, so in order to gather the footage for this film we had to take-off and land outside those areas as well as follow the Canadian regulations for "micro drones." We are happy to answer any other Canmore-related questions that you have. We hope you enjoy this film and are inspired to visit Canmore or the surrounding area someday. Please "like" this film and "subscribe" to our channel if you enjoy this film and would like to see more of our upcoming content from our trip to Canada.

Music is Forever by Tuneful Tones.
